usage: deskops atoms [-h]
                     {add-namespace,list,reorganize,show,validate,create,delete,split,merge,crossroad,proto,type,tree} ...

positional arguments:
  {add-namespace,list,reorganize,show,validate,create,delete,split,merge,crossroad,proto,type,tree}
    add-namespace       Add an extensible atom tag namespace to
                        desk/atoms/tag-namespaces.yaml.
    list                List all atoms.
    reorganize          Move atoms into folders derived from the configured
                        atom_folder_axis tag namespace. Idempotent.
    show                Show an atom.
    validate            Validate one atom or all atoms for lifecycle safety
                        checks.
    create              Create one atom from a pill, graph finding, or diagram
                        source while preserving exact provenance.
    delete              Delete one atom after checking inbound references.
    split               Split one atom into new atoms while keeping the
                        original as a redirect stub.
    merge               Merge one source atom into an existing target atom
                        while rewriting inbound references.
    crossroad           Write the crossroad of a domain path: the mandatory
                        parent that describes what hangs below it.
    proto               Create a protoatom: a free atom with a title, content
                        and tags.
    type                Type a protoatom into another sldb model, keeping the
                        protoatom as a redirect stub.
    tree                Show the domain tree: crossroads and the documents
                        hanging from them.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
